svg.text: #667 Enterprise Computer-Use & Browser GUI Agent (CUA / Playwright / OmniParser) Sizer
Slashing 15-Step 1080p Visual Token Tax by 78.4% (30,300 -> 6,540 tok) & Sizing 500-Session Chromium Sandboxes vs. VDI
Anti-Pattern: Pure 1080p Screenshot CUA + Full Desktop VDI
• 15-Step Task Appending Full Screenshot History:
15 × 2,020 = 30,300 visual tokens/task (Quadratic KV growth across steps!)
• Step TTFT Degrades to 1,420 ms; Coordinate Guessing Misses Small Buttons
(84.5% task completion; high retry loops on dense ERP tables).
• Full Windows/Linux Desktop VDI Pool (8 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 28s boot):
500 concurrent sessions burn 4.0 TB RAM across 16× 128-Core CPU Hosts!
500 Concurrent Sessions (Naive 1080p + VDI):
Requires 28× H200 VLM GPUs + 16× 512GB CPU Hosts (4.0 TB RAM)
Step TTFT: 1,420 ms · UI Action Accuracy: 84.5%
Production Blueprint: Hybrid DOM/A11y + OmniParser ROI + MicroVM
1. Pruned Accessibility (A11y) / DOM Tree for 75% Standard Web Steps:
Only interactive nodes (`[id=14] <button>Submit`) = ~320 text tokens/step.
2. OmniParser YOLOv8 + Set-of-Marks (SoM) ROI Crop for 25% Canvas/ERP:
Bounding-box ID overlay + 2-Frame Sliding Window (evict screens < t-1).
Cuts cumulative tokens/task from 30,300 to 6,540 (-78.4%) & lifts accuracy to 94.8%!
3. Containerized Chromium + Xvfb / Firecracker Snapshot Pool (1.8 GB/sess):
140 ms snapshot restore, 4.44× higher density (4 CPU hosts vs. 16 VDI hosts).
500 Concurrent Sessions (Hybrid DOM/ROI + Chromium Pool):
Requires 6× H200 GPUs (-78.6%) + 4× 512GB CPU Hosts (0.9 TB RAM)
Step TTFT: 310 ms (4.58× faster) · UI Action Accuracy: 94.8% (+10.3 pts)
Cloud & AI SA Golden Rule for Computer-Use Agents (CUA / RPA Replacement):
Never retain more than 2 historical screenshots in KV context, and never ask VLMs to guess raw (x,y) pixels when DOM/A11y or OmniParser SoM IDs exist.
